title: The Providence Rider
author: McCammon, Robert
review:
It's safe to say that this series is definitely one of my all time favorites now. McCammon really utilizes and pays off a lot of stuff he's been setting up in the past few books here. Just a masterful plot that has a lot of interesting threads that all tie together in a satisfying way. Highly recommend this series and this book is in the tier of the first two books which are some of McCammon's best.

Really excited to continue this series, it's a ton of fun, has excellent writing, and interesting themes and characters that feel alive.
